script: The government secretly hoarded cheese in a cave, and never told the public how much. In the 1980s, dairy price supports paid farmers to overproduce milk, and the surplus turned into mountains of processed cheese nobody was buying. Officials stored it in underground limestone caves, block after block, ton after ton. The stockpile kept growing until it topped half a billion pounds sitting in the dark. Eventually it started to spoil, so the government quietly began giving it away to avoid admitting the waste. That cheese became the block on welfare tables across the country, and almost no one knew where it came from. The government had built a mountain of cheese, and buried the truth about it right along with it.

title: The Government Secretly Hoarded Cheese in a Cave
description:
In the 1980s, US dairy price supports created a surplus so large the government stored it in underground caves. When it started spoiling, they quietly gave it away instead of admitting the waste.
